about: Findings from tools/recipe-consistency.js that a person read and judged to be correct as the recipe stands, with the reason. A finding listed here is reported as an accepted exception instead of a defect. Add an entry only after reading the recipe; never to make the check pass.

pork-pie.stages-exceed-cook: The 3-hour simmer for the jelly runs while the pastry is made and the pie bakes and cools (60 minutes of prep, 105 minutes of baking, at least 3 hours of cooling), so it is not added to the cook time. The total already includes the cooling and the 4 hours of setting.

ofada-rice.stages-exceed-cook: The beef (50 minutes), the rice (30) and the pepper sauce (10 + 1 + 5 + 25) are cooked side by side, and the method now says so ("While the beef cooks", "Meanwhile"). The longest chain is the beef and the final 10-minute simmer: 60 minutes, the row's cook time.

christmas-pudding.stages-exceed-cook: The 2-hour steam in the last step reheats the pudding on the day it is served, after it has matured; it is not part of making it. The cook time is the 6-hour steam.

slow-cooker-porridge.stages-exceed-cook: "If your slow cooker runs hot, cook for 6 hours instead" is an alternative to the 8 hours, not a second stage.
